measurement_notes: All coordinate RMSDs computed with matched heavy-atom names in original frame, no whole-structure superposition. Backbone uses all 12 fragment backbone names including OP1/OP2/O2'/O4'.

Per-residue mapping and all bond values/residuals are in linked before/after JSON. Derived atomic-input models have verified same-frame forward mappings; SPQR and oxRNA have only a sequence-order mapping and their raw RMSDs are not accuracy measures.

Representative bond tolerance 0.10 Å (roughly 6–7% of typical covalent bond), used to flag deviations, never to silently accept or refine geometry. Rigid modes are asserted invariant to 1e-10 Å before PDB rounding. PDB rounding accounts for up to ~0.0015 Å bond differences.
Internucleotide O3–P mean, median, maximum, >2 Å and >4 Å counts are diagnostic only. Too-short links also remain a limitation.

SPQR input axes deviate from orthonormality slightly; original normalization is unchanged. SUGR in MC_map_sugar uses raw endpoint vectors; normalized output basis and limited native precision yield residuals up to ~0.012 Å. pdb2spqr purine sugar offset differs from simulator, and is not silently conflated.

oxRNA uses native COM, a2=a3×a1 right-handed row basis, 8.518 Å per simulation unit, uncentered official RNA proxy Kabsch, and source-defined 0.5 Å template-axis origin registration. This existing offset is not a new bond-closing shift.

oxRNA fitting residual mixes unit direction vectors and Å interaction sites; its mean 0.5992 is not an Å RMSD. Calibrated template-registration inverse recovers native COM/orientation; raw physical proxies retain finite fitting errors.
Fragment A3 classification: chi about −157.2 degrees and delta about 79.1 degrees for all four supplied bases, within official anti and C3-endo class_glp thresholds.
